actions.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Ordered to be reported without amendment favorably.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Affects researchers, national laboratories, institutions of higher education, private sector energy entities, and federal agency personnel.
Provides grant funding, mandates deep data probes, and establishes centers of excellence for geothermal technology.
Authorizes $5,000,000 annually for fiscal years 2027 through 2031 for specific programs, plus such sums as necessary for others.
dimensions.evidence: there are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out this subsection $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031.

dimensions.assessment: Amends multiple sections of existing law, adds definitions, establishes new grant programs, requires reports, and updates geological resource assessments.
Authorizes appropriations through fiscal year 2031 and mandates quadrennial and ongoing resource assessments.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031

missing_information: Total overall cost for 'such sums as are necessary' provisions
importance_detail.rationale: Amends the Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007 to expand research, development, grant programs, data repositories, and assessments for next-generation and supercritical geothermal systems.
